task.description:
Hard gate: validate TEST-DESIGNER Step 3 output for DDL-01, MIG-04, MIG-05, MIG-06 (all MUST). Verify every MUST AC has a runnable test OR a documented structural/non-testable justification (MIG-05 AC5 specifically -- confirm the justification is sound, i.e. that the design genuinely has no runtime code for this AC per the already-accepted CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR Step 1b decision, and that this is not being used to paper over a real gap). No error.SkipZigTest. Fixtures isolated. Confirm the DDL-01 AC5 rename/fix TEST-DESIGNER made (renamed pre-existing tests to avoid a name collision, added a new timing-based AC5 test) is real and doesn't break anything.

RE-VALIDATION (after REWORK 1): TEST-DESIGNER fixed TC-MIG-04-03 by seeding 40 fixture rows and forcing SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = off (mirroring the proven pattern in platform_migrations_control_table_test.zig). Claims zig build test-integration-mig04-mig05 is now a reproducible 9/9 (ran 3 times). Re-verify independently.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST AC traced to a real test or a sound non-testable justification
MIG-05 AC5 justification verified sound, not a cover for a real gap
Build steps genuinely pass with stated counts

result.summary: RE-VALIDATION after REWORK 1: TC-MIG-04-03 fix independently re-verified. The fix seeds 40 fixture rows (alternating pending/failed, random UUIDs) under a fresh migration_id before EXPLAIN, then forces SET LOCAL enable_seqscan = off inside a rolled-back transaction, mirroring the already-accepted pattern in platform_migrations_control_table_test.zig::resume_index_used_by_pending_or_failed_query. Confirmed non-vacuous: enable_seqscan=off does not error or force a specific index when none is usable -- Postgres always retains a seqscan fallback -- so the assertion (EXPLAIN output must literally contain the string platform_migrations_resume_idx) only passes if the planner actually selected that specific partial index (verified defined in migrations/1144_platform_migrations_control_table.sql line 38: CREATE INDEX ... resume_idx ON platform.platform_migrations (migration_id, status) WHERE status IN (pending, failed)). This is a genuine regression check, not a tautology. Ran zig build test-integration-mig04-mig05 --summary all twice with BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test and BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5432/bpm_dev explicitly set: both runs reported 9/9 tests passed, exit code 0. cleanupControlRows (deferred immediately after migration_id creation, deletes by migration_id) tears down all 40 seeded rows even on failure. tests/specs/MIG-04.md TC-MIG-04-03 description matches the fixed test exactly (40 seeded rows, SET LOCAL enable_seqscan off, cost-grounded + forced determinism rationale). Re-confirmed via git diff fda513bf~1..fda513bf that REWORK 1 touched only migration_resume_test.zig, tests/specs/MIG-04.md, and handoff bookkeeping -- DDL-01 (21/21), MIG-06 (6/6), and the MIG-05 AC5 structural non-testable justification are untouched and remain valid from the original pass. Zero error.SkipZigTest matches in migration_resume_test.zig and platform_migrations_admin_test.zig.
